description: Expose one of the host's LOCAL ports at a public https://*.trycloudflare.com URL via a Cloudflare quick tunnel (downloads `cloudflared` on demand). Useful to share a local dev server. The host must be in edit/bypass mode. Returns the public URL; the tunnel stays up until tunnel_stop. target is a local address like 'http://localhost:3000' or just a port '3000'.

agent_id.description: Optional: ID of remote agent. If omitted, executes locally.

target.description: Local address to expose, e.g. 'http://localhost:3000' or a bare port '3000'

name: tunnel_start
